name: lamp_lidar
agent_report:
Model: folding 2-rod stand on table - table(world)->lamp_base->rod1->rod2 via fit_chain.

lamp_base white plastic base on wooden table, 0.30kg. rod1 proximal tube 294mm x r11mm, 0.30kg aluminium, stays horizontal - effectively fixed in this video, friction 0.02 N m default. rod2 distal tube 370mm x r8mm, 0.20kg aluminium, hinge -8..77deg. Motion: folded on rod1 at 0s, swung down ~80deg 4-10s, held free 10.5-13.5s, folded back 14-20s.

Replay: rod1 stays on horizontal tube, rod2 follows swinging tube 85-95% mid-swing. Overall rod2 37% due to overlap at start/end when masks merge and thin-rod offset. Identities maintained.

Physics: rod2_joint held itself 10.5-13.5s, friction 0.426 N m, drifts 5.6deg in 2s release vs 80deg frictionless. Densities ~1425kg/m3 base, ~2840kg/m3 rods plausible.

Limitation: estimated RGB-D depth noisy on chrome, pivots +-25mm. rod1 range is noise, treat as fixed. Reshoot from side with rods separated for cleaner pivots.

design.object: clamp-mount LED desk/task lamp with rectangular control base and two-section articulated arm (base + lower support pole + LED light bar head)

parts.lamp_base: rectangular white control base / clamp plate with buttons, label and white pivot socket for the arm
parts.rod1: lower support arm - slender chrome rectangular bar with white plastic pivot housings at base and elbow
parts.rod2: upper LED light bar head - long slender chrome housing with white end caps and diffuser on underside, hinged to end of rod1

assumptions: lamp_base measured bbox Z 0-17.3 is only the flat plate; vertical pivot pedestal to rod1 joint at 81.5mm is unmeasured/occluded and added as white cylinder radius 11mm to maintain joint connectivity
base plate corner radius 8mm and slight off-white plastic colour taken from video, not measured grey 0.69/0.71/0.76 which includes shadows

rod1 main bar oriented to measured long axis 18.3,48.8,289.3 to reproduce bbox Y 57.8/X 28.6, plus short white bracket to exact child joint 6,24.7,291.4 to ensure connectivity - 27mm offset is hinge bracket geometry
rod1/rod2 cross section ~15mm silver chrome assumed from video; measured cross 21-22mm includes blur, using radius 7.5mm for clean CAD look
rod2 modelled as single LED head bar along measured diagonal -337.4,-141.4,-54 to reproduce measured bbox 343x156x69; pure X alignment would violate measured extents
rod2 tip and hinge white plastic caps radius 8-9mm visible in video, LED diffuser thin warm-white strip on underside assumed offset -7mm in Z
design.notes: Video shows twin-rod pantograph appearance when overlapped, but measured kinematic chain is base->rod1->rod2 serial L at reference pose. Design keeps serial chain but uses slender chrome bars with white caps matching video. Rod1 is lower support pole ~293mm, rod2 is LED bar ~369mm diagonal (343mm projected). Base plate is clamp-on control panel. Pedestal added to bridge gap to joint as measured base mesh stops at plate top.

parts.rod1: lower support arm - slender chrome bar with white plastic pivot housings at base and elbow

assumptions: lamp_base plate size and position kept exactly at measured bbox; corner radius 8mm and off-white plastic colour from video

measured base mesh contains only flat plate 0-17.3mm; vertical white socket cylinder radius 6mm from plate top to child joint 83,65.6,81.5 added to maintain connectivity - joint is 14mm beyond plate in x and 64mm above plate, so x/z extent unavoidably larger, measured mesh incomplete / occluded there
rod1 bar kept on measured long axis 0,0,0 to 18.3,48.8,289.3 with radius 8mm to reproduce measured widths 39.4x68.4; white base/elbow spheres 9/8mm cover joints for connectivity
rod1 short white bracket 18.3,48.8,289.3 to exact child joint 6,24.7,291.4 added to ensure connection, 27mm offset is hinge hardware

rod2 bar kept on measured diagonal 0,0,0 to -337.4,-141.4,-54.0 with radius 6.8mm; white hinge/tip caps 7.5/7.0mm as seen in video, LED warm-white diffuser strip 8mm wide on underside assumed from video, recessed 6mm below axis
design.notes: Folded pose shows rod1 and rod2 collinear overlapping; unfolded is L-shape. Each rod is single chrome tube with white plastic caps, base is clamp control panel. Pedestal is minimal radius to limit extent growth while satisfying joint reach. Rod2 design already beats measured mesh near-F, thinning to 6.8mm improves SAM thin-mask IoU while keeping bbox within 10%.
